What is an evil twin attack?
A rogue wireless AP that mimics a legitimate SSID to trick users into connecting
Two switches on the same channel
Which goal does an evil twin typically serve?
Intercepting traffic or harvesting credentials from connected users
How can an evil twin be distinguished from the real network?
By checking the BSSID and other details rather than the SSID alone
Which authentication method helps clients avoid connecting to an evil twin on enterprise Wi-Fi?
Which user behavior increases evil twin risk?
Automatically connecting to open networks with familiar names
Which protection keeps data confidential even if a user connects to an evil twin?
Which wireless security feature helps clients detect a fake authentication server?
Validating the RADIUS server certificate in WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise
Which tool helps organizations detect evil twin APs near their premises?
Which feature of an evil twin makes it convincing to users?
It broadcasts the same SSID as a trusted network
Which practice helps users on public Wi-Fi reduce evil twin risk?
Using a VPN and verifying HTTPS certificates
Which statement about evil twins and captive portals is TRUE?
A fake captive portal can harvest credentials from users who enter them
Which configuration reduces the chance employees auto-connect to a spoofed corporate SSID?
Using 802.1X so clients validate the network before joining
Which security goal is MOST threatened by an evil twin?
Confidentiality of user traffic and credentials
Which detail should a security team monitor to spot an evil twin impersonating their SSID?
Unknown BSSIDs advertising the corporate SSID
Which statement about evil twins and signal strength is TRUE?
An evil twin may use a stronger signal to attract clients
Which practice helps users verify they joined the legitimate network?
Confirming the expected certificate and avoiding open clones
Which response is appropriate after detecting an evil twin on-site?
Locate it, where legal use containment, and alert users
Which statement about WPA3 and evil twins is TRUE?
WPA3 and PMF improve protection, but certificate validation and VPNs still matter
WPA3 removes the need for VPNs
Which user-side setting reduces evil twin risk on laptops and phones?
Disabling automatic connection to open or unknown networks
Which statement about enterprise certificate validation and evil twins is TRUE?
If clients require a valid server certificate, a fake AP without it is rejected
Which monitoring approach detects an evil twin broadcasting over time?
Continuous wireless scanning and alerting on rogue SSIDs/BSSIDs
Which statement about evil twins and credential reuse is TRUE?
Harvested credentials may be reused elsewhere, so MFA reduces impact
Which practice helps protect corporate Wi-Fi users traveling in public areas?
Always-on VPN and enterprise authentication profiles
Which statement about an evil twin's upstream connection is TRUE?
It often forwards traffic to the internet so victims don't notice the interception
Which security awareness message helps prevent evil twin success?
Verify networks and never ignore certificate warnings
Which statement about hidden SSIDs and evil twins is TRUE?
Hiding an SSID does not reliably prevent spoofing
Which control helps a laptop reject a spoofed site after connecting to an evil twin?
TLS certificate validation in the browser
Which statement about evil twins in airports and cafes is TRUE?
Public venues are common targets, so users should use a VPN
Which practice helps IT confirm which AP a user actually connected to?
Checking the BSSID the client associated with
Which statement about evil twins and MFA-protected logins is TRUE?
MFA makes stolen passwords less useful to attackers
Which response reduces ongoing risk after an evil twin incident?
Reset exposed credentials and reinforce certificate validation and VPN use
Which statement about enterprise Wi-Fi profiles and evil twins is TRUE?
Preconfigured profiles can pin the correct server certificate to reject fakes
Which detail distinguishes a legitimate enterprise network from an evil twin to a validating client?
Which statement about evil twins and guest networks is TRUE?
Even on guest networks, users should use encryption since the AP may be fake
Evil twins can't mimic guest SSIDs
Which tool output helps a technician identify multiple APs using the same SSID?
A wireless analyzer showing SSIDs and their BSSIDs
Which statement about evil twins and auto-join behavior is TRUE?
Devices that auto-join saved SSIDs may connect to a spoof with the same name
Saved SSIDs are verified by name only safely
Which practice helps detect an evil twin impersonating a specific store's Wi-Fi?
Comparing observed BSSIDs to the known, authorized AP list
Which statement about evil twins and corporate laptops is TRUE?
Enforced enterprise profiles and VPNs reduce the chance of successful interception
Which first action helps a user who suspects they joined an evil twin?
Disconnect, avoid entering credentials, and switch to a trusted network or VPN
Which statement about evil twins and HTTPS-only sites is TRUE?
HTTPS with valid certificates makes silent interception harder
Which monitoring capability would alert on a sudden second AP with the corporate SSID?
Rogue/evil twin detection in a WIPS
Which statement about user training and evil twins is TRUE?
Training users to verify networks and heed warnings reduces success
Which practice helps reduce evil twin impact for remote workers?
Requiring VPN use on all untrusted networks
Which statement about evil twins and PSK networks is TRUE?
PSK networks without server validation are easier to impersonate than 802.1X
Which detail should be documented to support evil twin investigations?
Authorized AP BSSIDs, locations, and channels
Which statement about evil twins and certificate pinning in apps is TRUE?
Pinned apps reject connections that present an unexpected certificate
Which control combination BEST protects enterprise users from evil twins?
802.1X with certificate validation, VPNs, WIPS, and user awareness
Which statement about evil twin detection latency is TRUE?
Continuous wireless monitoring detects spoofed APs faster than occasional checks
Which action reduces the value of credentials potentially exposed to an evil twin?
Enforcing MFA and prompt password resets when exposure is suspected
Which BEST summarizes evil twin defense?
Use enterprise authentication with certificate validation, VPNs on untrusted networks, wireless intrusion detection, and user awareness
